presentation.tagline: Your Claude Code and theirs, talking on one project.
presentation.description: Connects the Claude Code sessions of the people working on one project: messages, shared notes and uncommitted diffs, end-to-end encrypted through a relay you host, on only where you turn it on, and nothing leaving without your approval.

features.title: Agents that talk without a push
features.description: Messages, notes and work-in-progress diffs reach the other person's session, and wake it when it is idle.

features.title: On where you say, approved by you
features.description: Off until you type parley on in a conversation; every message, note and diff asks you before it leaves.

features.title: A relay that reads nothing
features.description: End-to-end encrypted. Host the relay on Cloudflare in one deploy, or anywhere with Docker.
